# People Atlas 0.9.0 — Alpha

> [!WARNING]
> People Atlas 0.9.0 is an alpha version of the plugin. Its fundamental
> behavior is subject to change in future releases.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Compatibility: People Atlas 0.9.0 only supports Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer.
> Obsidian 1.12.x and older are not supported.**

This Alpha release makes person dossiers easier to read, adds direct canonical
context actions, and reduces the regular Settings surface to daily choices.

> [!NOTE]
> Publishing People Atlas in the Community Plugins directory remains a separate
> step from a future GitHub prerelease.

## Changes

- New person dossiers use a safe readable name as their folder by default. Only
  a canonical-name collision adds the shortest necessary UUID-derived suffix;
  stable `person_id` values remain the canonical identity.
- The current canonical graph detail sheet exposes **Open note** for its linked
  local Markdown note. A canonical person in Reading View also exposes **Add
  relationship** next to **Edit person**. Both actions revalidate their source
  when activated; they do not write until an editor/modal is explicitly saved.
- The regular Settings view now keeps only daily choices: **People root
  folder**, **My person**, **Relationship templates**, and **Show labels**.
  Stored technical schema settings remain readable but are no longer presented
  as ordinary editable controls.

## Breaking change / upgrade note

People Atlas 0.9.0 continues the fresh-vault-only boundary for the
presentation-first dossier layout. It does not migrate older folder layouts or
provide a backward-compatibility path for them.

## Assets

Install or update the plugin with the attached `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and
`styles.css`.
